# SERO Package Test

This document demonstrates the functionality of the SERO (Spatial Emergency Response Optimization) package.

## 1. Package Installation and Loading

```{r load-packages}
# Load required packages
library(SERO)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Check package version and functions
packageVersion("SERO")
```

## 2. Load Sample Data

```{r load-data}
# Load the built-in sample data
data <- sero_load_data()

# Display data structure
str(data, max.level = 1)

# Check what data components we have
names(data)
```

## 3. Data Validation

```{r validate-data}
# Check data structure first
cat("Data layers available:\n")
print(names(data))

# Basic data info
for (layer in names(data)) {
  if (inherits(data[[layer]], "sf")) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: %d features\n", layer, nrow(data[[layer]])))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: %s\n", layer, class(data[[layer]])))
  }
}
```

## 4. Enhanced Hotspot Analysis

```{r hotspot-analysis}
# Perform enhanced hotspot analysis with customizable intensity
if ("accident" %in% names(data) && inherits(data$accident, "sf")) {
  
  cat("Testing enhanced hotspot analysis with different intensity levels...\n")
  
  # Test different intensity levels
  intensity_levels <- c("low", "medium", "high")
  
  for (intensity in intensity_levels) {
    cat(sprintf("\n--- %s Intensity Analysis ---\n", toupper(intensity)))
    
    # Perform hotspot analysis
    tryCatch({
      hotspot_result <- sero_hotspot_analysis(
        data = data,
        intensity = intensity,
        include_landuse = TRUE,
        contour_levels = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)
      )
      
      # Display results
      print(hotspot_result$plot)
      cat(sprintf("Total accidents analyzed: %d\n", hotspot_result$stats$total_accidents))
      cat(sprintf("Bandwidth used: %.2f meters\n", hotspot_result$stats$density_bandwidth))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Enhanced hotspot analysis not available, using basic analysis:\n")
      
      # Fallback to basic analysis
      accidents_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(data$accident, 4326)
      districts_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(data$districts, 4326)
      
      plot(st_geometry(districts_wgs84), main = paste("Accidents -", intensity, "view"))
      plot(st_geometry(accidents_wgs84), add = TRUE, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
      
      cat("Basic visualization completed\n")
    })
    
    # Only show first intensity level to avoid too much output
    break
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Accident data not found or not in sf format\n")
}
```

## 5. Enhanced Optimal Location Analysis

```{r optimal-locations}
# Find optimal emergency service locations using advanced algorithms
if ("accident" %in% names(data) && "districts" %in% names(data)) {
  cat("Testing enhanced optimal location analysis...\n")
  
  # Test different optimization methods
  methods <- c("hybrid", "kmeans", "density")
  
  for (method in methods) {
    cat(sprintf("\n--- %s Method ---\n", toupper(method)))
    
    tryCatch({
      # Find optimal locations using enhanced algorithm
      optimal_result <- sero_optimal_locations(
        data = data,
        num_locations = 3,
        method = method,
        save_locations = TRUE
      )
      
      # Display results
      print(optimal_result$plot)
      cat("Optimal locations found:\n")
      print(optimal_result$locations)
      
      cat("\nPerformance metrics:\n")
      cat(sprintf("Average distance to accidents: %.2f meters\n", 
                 optimal_result$performance$avg_distance_m))
      cat(sprintf("Maximum distance: %.2f meters\n", 
                 optimal_result$performance$max_distance_m))
      cat(sprintf("90th percentile coverage: %.2f meters\n", 
                 optimal_result$performance$coverage_90_percent))
      
      # Update data with optimal locations for routing
      if (!is.null(optimal_result$data_updated)) {
        data <- optimal_result$data_updated
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Enhanced optimal analysis not available, using basic analysis:\n")
      
      # Fallback to basic centroid calculation
      accidents_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(data$accident, 4326)
      districts_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(data$districts, 4326)
      
      accident_coords <- st_coordinates(accidents_wgs84)
      center_x <- mean(accident_coords[,1])
      center_y <- mean(accident_coords[,2])
      
      cat(sprintf("Basic centroid: (%.6f, %.6f)\n", center_x, center_y))
      
      plot(st_geometry(districts_wgs84), main = paste("Optimal Location -", method))
      plot(st_geometry(accidents_wgs84), add = TRUE, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.3)
      points(center_x, center_y, col = "blue", pch = 19, cex = 2)
      
      # Create simple optimal locations for routing test
      optimal_locations_basic <- sf::st_as_sf(
        data.frame(
          id = c("OPT_1", "OPT_2", "OPT_3"),
          lon = c(center_x, center_x + 0.01, center_x - 0.01),
          lat = c(center_y, center_y + 0.01, center_y - 0.01)
        ),
        coords = c("lon", "lat"),
        crs = 4326
      )
      data$optimal_locations <- optimal_locations_basic
    })
    
    # Only test first method to avoid too much output
    break
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Required spatial data not available\n")
}
```

## 6. Enhanced Emergency Routing Analysis

```{r route-analysis}
# Test enhanced emergency routing with simulated new accident
if ("optimal_locations" %in% names(data)) {
  cat("Testing enhanced emergency routing...\n")
  
  # Simulate a new accident location (within Munster district bounds)
  tryCatch({
    districts_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(data$districts, 4326)
    bbox <- sf::st_bbox(districts_wgs84)
    
    # Create simulated accident location
    sim_accident_lon <- bbox[1] + (bbox[3] - bbox[1]) * 0.6
    sim_accident_lat <- bbox[2] + (bbox[4] - bbox[2]) * 0.4
    
    cat(sprintf("Simulated accident location: (%.6f, %.6f)\n", sim_accident_lon, sim_accident_lat))
    
    # Test different routing methods
    routing_methods <- c("euclidean", "road_network", "hybrid")
    
    for (method in routing_methods) {
      cat(sprintf("\n--- %s Routing ---\n", toupper(method)))
      
      # Calculate emergency route
      route_result <- sero_emergency_routing(
        data = data,
        new_accident_coords = c(sim_accident_lon, sim_accident_lat),
        routing_method = method,
        include_roads = TRUE
      )
      
      # Display results
      print(route_result$plot)
      cat("Route Statistics:\n")
      cat(sprintf("Nearest service location: %s\n", route_result$statistics$nearest_location_id))
      cat(sprintf("Distance: %d meters (%.2f km)\n", 
                 route_result$statistics$distance_meters,
                 route_result$statistics$distance_km))
      cat(sprintf("Estimated travel time: %.1f minutes\n", 
                 route_result$statistics$estimated_travel_time_min))
      
      # Only test first method to avoid too much output
      break
    }
    
    # Create interactive routing map (will be available for user interaction)
    cat("\nCreating interactive routing map...\n")
    interactive_map <- create_interactive_routing_map(
      data = data,
      optimal_locations = sf::st_transform(data$optimal_locations, 4326),
      districts = districts_wgs84,
      include_roads = TRUE
    )
    
    cat("Interactive map created successfully!\n")
    cat("Note: In a real application, users can click on the map to simulate new accidents.\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Enhanced routing not available, using basic distance analysis:\n")
    
    # Fallback to basic distance calculation
    if (exists("center_x") && exists("center_y")) {
      accident_coords <- st_coordinates(data$accident)
      distances <- sqrt((accident_coords[,1] - center_x)^2 + (accident_coords[,2] - center_y)^2)
      
      cat(sprintf("Average distance to accidents: %.2f meters\n", mean(distances) * 111320))
      cat(sprintf("Maximum distance: %.2f meters\n", max(distances) * 111320))
      cat(sprintf("Minimum distance: %.2f meters\n", min(distances) * 111320))
      
      hist(distances * 111320, main = "Distance Distribution", 
           xlab = "Distance (meters)", col = "lightblue", breaks = 10)
    } else {
      cat("No optimal locations available for routing analysis\n")
    }
  })
  
} else {
  cat("No optimal locations found. Run optimal location analysis first.\n")
}
```

## 7. Data Summary and Statistics

```{r data-summary}
# Basic statistics about the dataset
cat("Dataset Summary:\n")
cat("===============\n")

for (layer_name in names(data)) {
  layer <- data[[layer_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n", layer_name))
  
  if (inherits(layer, "sf")) {
    cat(sprintf("  - Type: Spatial features (sf)\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  - Features: %d\n", nrow(layer)))
    cat(sprintf("  - Columns: %d\n", ncol(layer)))
    cat(sprintf("  - CRS: %s\n", ifelse(is.na(st_crs(layer)), "Not set", as.character(st_crs(layer)))))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  - Type: %s\n", class(layer)[1]))
    if (is.data.frame(layer)) {
      cat(sprintf("  - Rows: %d\n", nrow(layer)))
      cat(sprintf("  - Columns: %d\n", ncol(layer)))
    }
  }
}
```

## 8. Package Function Testing

```{r function-testing}
# Test which SERO functions are available
cat("Available SERO functions:\n")
sero_functions <- ls("package:SERO", pattern = "^sero_")
if (length(sero_functions) > 0) {
  for (func in sero_functions) {
    cat(sprintf("  - %s\n", func))
  }
} else {
  cat("  No SERO functions found with sero_ prefix\n")
}

# Test core function existence
core_functions <- c("sero_optimal", "sero_data", "sero_hotspots")
cat("\nCore function availability:\n")
for (func in core_functions) {
  exists_func <- exists(func, mode = "function")
  cat(sprintf("  - %s: %s\n", func, ifelse(exists_func, "Available", "Not found")))
}
```
